summary: Tested Atypic Calendar (FastAPI + Expo/React Native). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed covering templates, events CRUD, capacity blocking with French message, /events/check, day & range energy, stats, suggestions (default 'calm'), update/delete, and _id exclusion. Frontend (mobile 390x844): onboarding screen with testID 'onboarding-start-btn' renders and navigates to calendar; 3 animated donuts (cognitive/social/sensory) render; mode segmented control switches Jour/Semaine/Mois; FAB opens new-event modal; all 10 templates render with testID 'template-{id}'; selecting 'medecin' fills title 'Médecin' and impacts; type pills task/resource present; saving valid event closes modal and adds event card to day view; stats tab shows KPIs (fatigue, surcharge, events, energy) + donuts + trend chart; settings tab shows the 3 reserves with descriptions and À propos.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' from react-native-reanimated/svg on web. Non-blocking but should be addressed by main agent.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo reports react-native-svg@15.15.4 expected 15.12.1 - cosmetic compatibility warning, app still works

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow on web or use Platform.select to silence warnings.
(Optional) Pin react-native-svg to 15.12.1 to match installed Expo SDK expected version.

Note: The frontend capacity-exceeded UI flow was exercised but the chosen impacts (-50 on each axis from 85/60/75) did not actually exceed capacity (resulted in 35/10/25). The backend rule and Alert handler in /app/frontend/app/event/new.tsx (lines 107-115) are implemented correctly; backend pytest test_create_event_blocked_when_capacity_exceeded validates the 400 + French detail behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 370 lines and well-structured. All Mongo queries exclude _id via projection {'_id': 0}. Uses uuid for ids — good.
event creation does not validate impacts within [-100,100]; Pydantic models declare it as int with no bound. Low priority.
EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is read once at module load in lib/api.ts. OK for Expo.
Frontend uses TouchableOpacity, Text, View consistently and StyleSheet.create — compliant.
All interactive elements have testID — coverage is excellent.
seed_data_creation: Tests create events under year 2099 dates (auto-cleaned) and one '2026-05-09' event during UI test that was manually deleted post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL points to preview ingress. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_atypic.py is reusable. Tab labels are 'Calendrier', 'Statistiques', 'Paramètres' (do not search for 'Settings'). Native Alert dialogs (Alert.alert) cannot be inspected via DOM on web preview — verify capacity-exceeded behavior via backend test or by listening to console / inspecting fact that modal stays open.
